rubric.role_summary: Scientific proposal writer for an applied AI research organization, collaborating with researchers on grant proposals, project specifications, and technical communications for varied audiences. Full-time or part-time employment is accepted.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Scientific proposal writer for an applied AI research organization, collaborating with researchers on grant proposals, project specifications, and technical communications for varied audiences. Full-time or part-time employment is accepted.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- At least three years of grant writing and editing experience.
- PhD or equivalent experience in a technical area.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience writing successful scientific grants, particularly for NSF, DARPA, and/or NIH.
- A solid foundation in technical or mathematical concepts.
- Ability to synthesize complex information for various audiences and adapt writing style to different modes.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York metropolitan area; Greater Boston area, Massachusetts. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.

Interest in and capacity to understand the organization's core technical research.
Comfort collaborating closely with research teams and translating their work into writing.
Ideally, genuine interest in AI, its societal implications, and the organization's mission.
